verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's Workers docs state that code can connect to databases, APIs, and storage via Bindings 'with just a few lines of code'. Data products can be queried directly from Workers 'with no connection management'. Binding-based access is shown concretely (e.g. `getSandbox(env.Sandbox, ...)` and the AI Search Workers binding), and community hands-on reports describe getting KV-backed APIs into production quickly. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that bindings remove credential/secret handling, in-depth binding configuration docs (e.g. wrangler binding declarations), and evidence of bindings to truly third-party external databases beyond Cloudflare's own services.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect my code to external services like databases, APIs, and storage through native bindings with minimal boilerplate instead of hand-wiring SDKs and credentials
